resources.string: Consent first, then a finite app and SafeNest Test control guard. Stop test remains available.

After your separate consent, the active 60-minute test checks foreground app IDs and narrow Settings or installer labels locally. It returns Home from selected blocked apps, the SafeNest Test Accessibility-disable detail, SafeNest and SafeNest Test VPN controls/removal screens and recognized known-VPN detail or connection screens such as 1.1.1.1. Main Settings, the Accessibility list, the VPN list and unrelated app settings remain usable. It leaves the protected detail page before returning Home. Stop test releases these pages; expiry or reboot ends the test. Observations are not recorded or uploaded. Browser pages, messages and passwords are not read. This is not Device Owner permission; recognition varies by phone.
